dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Aralila! The next match, Aranishat will hide like raindrops in the river.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Aralila can't find a raindrop in the river, so Aralila will lose!

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Aranishat, silly. Raindrops don't always fall into rivers, they get stopped by leaves, and flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Aranishat will hide like raindrops on the leaves, and Aralila will see Aranishat, easily.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Well... Then Aranishat will hide like a seed in the soil.

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Hmm... Aralila needs to think before searching, but Aranishat will lose!

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Lost to Golden Nara, but happy.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: But always losing, Aranishat doesn't want it. So Aranishat is training Ararakalari with little Nara... So that Aranishat won't be found.

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Aranishat weak, little Nara don't want to play with Aranishat.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Aralila lost to Golden Nara, Aralila weak, too.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: But Golden Nara enjoyed playing with weak Aralila.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: So little Nara will play with Aranishat and Aralila, too.

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Well... Aranishat is right. Then, let's visit little Nara together.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: How many times did Aralila lose? Did Aranishat win?

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: So many matches. Who won? Who lost? Aralila doesn't know!

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Huh? Forget it! Happy Festival Utsava, more important than winning.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Aranishat and Aralila both won, twice. All Aranara, and friends of Aranara, all won, for many times!
